What Is ACRS?

Asian Counseling and Referral Service (ACRS) is a nonprofit organization that promotes the well-being of Asian Pacific Americans and other underserved communities through culturally appropriate mental health, social, and community services. We believe everyone deserves access to quality care -- in their own language, in their own community.

Learn More at acrs.org
Our Programs

More Ways to Share ACRS Programs

Know someone who could benefit from ACRS services? Here are some of our most requested programs. Share directly via email or social media.

Mental Health

Behavioral Health Services

ACRS offers culturally responsive counseling, therapy, and case management in multiple languages for individuals and families facing mental health challenges.

acrs.org/behavioral-health
Workforce

Employment & Job Training

From resume workshops to supported employment programs, ACRS connects job seekers with training, placement, and the tools to build lasting careers.

acrs.org/employment-services
Seniors

Senior Services & Club Bamboo

ACRS Club Bamboo provides older adults with meals, social activities, language support, and case management -- keeping seniors connected, healthy, and thriving.
